content: mlfinlab (Hudson & Thames) original triple-barrier-labeling reference implementation now closed/commercial-licensed for newer versions; lightweight open alternatives exist (triple-barrier on PyPI, mchiuminatto/triple_barrier on GitHub) built on pandas/numpy, sufficient for a single-trader project rather than depending on a commercial package. Recommendation: implement triple-barrier labeling directly in src/ml_model.py (it's a well-defined ~50-line algorithm) rather than adding a new dependency.
